title: Symbotic Reports Fourth-Quarter Revenue of $778 Million, Up 26%
summary: Symbotic reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $778 million, up 26% year-over-year, and net income of $55 million, according to its release.
body_markdown:
For the full fiscal year 2026, Symbotic reported revenue of $2.8 billion, up 25% year-over-year, net income of $133 million and adjusted EBITDA of $354 million. Cash and cash equivalents totaled $2.0 billion at the end of the quarter, up from $1.7 billion at the end of the third quarter of fiscal 2026.


For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, the company expects revenue of $805 million to $825 million and adjusted EBITDA of $110 million to $120 million. Symbotic said it is not providing guidance for net income, the most comparable GAAP measure. In its[investor presentation](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1837240/000183724026000047/symboticinvestorpresenta.htm) , Symbotic reported a total backlog of $22.3 billion as of the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, with 84 systems in deployment and 59 operational systems.


## Why It Matters for SYM


Chief Financial Officer Izzy Martins said: "Year-over-year revenue growth accelerated in the fiscal fourth quarter, and we delivered our first full year of GAAP profitability." Looking at the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Martins said the company sees it "highlighted by accelerating year-over-year revenue growth and significant backlog expansion."
